summary: Fintech products for venues and merchants, shipped to web, iOS and Android.
highlights: Own the Box Office web panel end to end since its first commit: ticket and product sales, wallet top-ups, customer management and reporting, used daily by venue staff (React, RTK Query, Zod).
Built the JoyPort customer wallet app for iOS, Android and web almost single-handedly: OTP sign-in, onboarding, QR payments and account management (Expo, NativeWind).
Main contributor to the company's React component library and contributor to its React Native counterpart (Radix UI, Tailwind, Storybook).
Shipped the PAX POS device mode with NFC card payments in the merchant terminal app, a customer-facing ticket booking site, and wallet and payment features in the WaaS web app.
